name: kestrel-acp
description: Run Kestrel tasks with native streaming, approvals, files, and terminals in VS Code.

kestrel.acpExecutable.description: Absolute path or PATH-resolved Kestrel ACP executable.

kestrel.model.description: Model ID passed to the ACP host; falls back to KESTREL_MODEL.

kestrel.providers.description: Provider IDs passed to the ACP host; falls back to KESTREL_PROVIDERS.

kestrel.mcpServers.description: ACP MCP server descriptors passed during session creation.
